vs_bar.consensus_source: https://www.marketbeat.com/instant-alerts/upcoming-vicor-vicr-expected-to-post-earnings-on-tuesday-2026-10-13/ ($187.03m; Benzinga $187.1m, Zacks $187.20m per the stage E-P hunt)
Nasdaq EPS forecast carried in the brief (fallback, 2 estimates); MarketBeat $1.32 and Benzinga $1.27 per the hunt; Zacks $1.39 per a search snippet (snippet_only)
vs_bar.note: In line to slightly below depending on the source: +0.8% vs MarketBeat $1.32, +4.7% vs Benzinga $1.27, -3.6% vs Nasdaq $1.38, -4.3% vs Zacks $1.39. Opex rose to $62.5m from $48.2m, including contingency fees to IP law firms, which absorbed much of the royalty.

vs_bar.consensus_source: no sourced consensus; the hunt's own walk assumed ~$33m+ of royalty

key_line.detail: The release gives no Q4 guidance, which is the company's practice. Royalty of $66.6m (vs $21.7m a year ago) is about double what the hunt's walk assumed and likely contains catch-up royalties; whether it recurs in Q4 is not answered in the release. Positives on the licensing line: first VPD license to an AI OEM at Stage-2 unit royalty rates, and the ITC institution 'is prompting license inquiries from unlicensed OEMs and Hyperscalers'. Capacity: two more sites bought, 'nearly 5X' capacity from 3 fabs (capex, cash $513.1m).

guidance.detail: No Q4 or FY guidance in the release (the company declined quarterly guidance on earlier calls too). Street had a Q4 EPS consensus of ~$1.27 (Benzinga, per the hunt) and a company FY2026 floor of >$600m from the Q2 call; anything said on the 08:00 ET call about Q4 royalties was not found.

call.detail: Call scheduled 08:00 ET today per the release, so it has taken place or is ending as the session opens. No transcript, summary or headline from it was found by 09:05 ET; the pre-market traded a wide $183.0-$207.9 range, which fits a market digesting the call in real time. The main open question (does Q3's royalty recur in Q4) was most likely addressed there and is unknown to this review.

public_reaction.summary: Almost nothing indexed yet: searches returned the 8-K exhibit and older Q3 2025 'Stock Track' items, no post-release analyst actions, no wire headline about today's move, and no retail source. One search snippet frames the result as a revenue beat and a few cents short on EPS vs Zacks (snippet_only). Retail tone not observed (0 = unknown, not neutral evidence).

tape_read.note: Pre-market last $195.00 at 08:57 ET (fresh) is +2.3% on the $190.68 prev close and 1.8% below the $198.67 entry, against a 16.55% implied move (median historical reaction, no option chain). The range $183.0 (-4.0%) to $207.9 (+9.0%) shows the market swung both ways and settled near flat: a revenue beat with a big royalty but EPS at the bar, opex eaten by contingency fees and no Q4 guide. Zero pre-market volume is a source artefact. QQQ is -0.44% pre-market, a mild headwind for a 2.4-beta chip-adjacent name. I read the price as fair to the release; the unresolved part is the call's Q4 royalty message, which the tape is still discovering.

thesis_check.note: The thesis was an EPS beat on near-100%-margin royalty plus licensing running ahead of guide, against Q4 royalty-durability risk. Licensing is confirmed (royalty $66.6m, new Stage-2-rate license, inquiries after the ITC case, backlog +7%), but the EPS beat did not arrive (contingency fees lifted opex $14m q/q, EPS $1.33 vs $1.27-1.39) and the durability question stays open with no Q4 guide.

recommendation.limit_basis: Inside this morning's pre-market range ($183.0-$207.9): roughly halfway from the $195.00 last to the $207.9 pre-market high, +5.9% on the prev close and +3.6% above the last, about a fifth of the 16.55% implied move. With 20-day realised volatility near 109% (a daily sd of ~7%), an intraday touch of +3.6% is close to a coin flip or better, and it sits above the $198.67 entry.
recommendation.reason: De cijfers zijn gemengd: omzet en royalty's ruim boven verwachting, maar de winst per aandeel ligt rond de verwachting omdat advocatenkosten veel opslokten, en er is geen vooruitzicht voor Q4. De voorbeurskoers (+2,3%) slingerde tussen -4% en +9% en lijkt de cijfers redelijk te prijzen; een bmo-naam beweegt vaak nog door tot het slot. Leg daarom een verkooplimiet op $202 om een uitschieter naar boven te pakken, en verkoop anders aan het slot.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als voor 09:30 berichten over het gesprek van 08:00 melden dat de royalty's in Q4 duidelijk dalen (eenmalige inhaalbetaling) en de voorbeurskoers onder $188 zakt, dan direct bij de opening verkopen.
